hook.text: Alibaba connects 10 million sellers to buyers in 190 countries. AliExpress is its consumer-facing arm for the world.

buildup.text: Alibaba started as a B2B platform for Chinese manufacturers. AliExpress launched in 2010 for individual consumers.

discovery.text: AliExpress offers factory-direct prices: phone cases for $1, watches for $5. Margins are razor-thin but volume is huge.

twist.text: Quality varies wildly. The same listing can deliver a decent product or complete junk depending on the supplier.

climax.text: Alibaba created the infrastructure for Chinese goods to reach the world. Quality remains its biggest challenge.

punchline.text: 10M sellers, 190 countries. AliExpress brought factory prices to consumers.

quiz.question: What is the relationship between Alibaba and AliExpress?
options: AliExpress is Alibaba's consumer-facing platform for international shoppers
